== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand hears his [[Tamlin al'Thor|father]]'s voice telling him to let go. Then [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]]'s telling him that he must allow other people to sacrifice as well, echoing what Elayne said to him in her tent. 

He lets go of the guilt he feels due to not protecting them and the need to do so. He lets go of the list he had carried, that had once been the women who had died for him, but which had grown into all people who had. [[Ilyena Therin Moerelle|Ilyena]] was the last, and he feels as though a giant weight has been lifted from his shoulders. 

He stands up once more to face the Shadow.

:{{pov|[[Shendla]]}}
Shendla looks down to see that [[Demandred]] is dead. She screams out the loss of their leader to the [[Shara|Sharans]]. The battlefield seems to go still.

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand looks outside of time and sees the Dark One not as a being, but a force as wide as the universe. He feels more attacks coming from the Dark One, but shrugs them off, telling himself that if those fighting won't give in, he won't either. 

He seeks the void and tells the Dark One that he doesn't control the world.

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}
[[Loial]] returns to the northern end of the Heights to tell Mat that Demandred and [[Al'Lan Mandragoran|Lan]] are dead. 

Mat leads the charge.
